messages:
amelia: FYI BlueArc SI flagged a telemetry handshake error on AcmeHealth private deploy during validation. Requesting quick architecture review before we send field eng. Error seen in agent logs: `handshake timeout 30s`.

mattp: ack. timeline?

amelia: customer on Monday cutover. SI wants us to advise on ports/mtls config and fallback routing. They see TLS renegotiate failing intermittently.

raj: can you paste the agent log snippet? also which image tag?

amelia: sure — log:
```
2026-06-01T18:02:12Z agent[1]: telemetry: handshake failed: timeout waiting for proto response
2026-06-01T18:02:15Z agent[1]: retrying (3/5)
```
image: redwood/si-agent:1.4.2

sara: tagging ops: @ops-bot can you check whether the marketplace image has the mTLS cert bundle? last rotation was 2026-05-28.

ops-bot: (automated) Marketplace image redwood/si-agent:1.4.2 includes cert bundle v20260528. No active revocations. :white_check_mark:

raj: could be SNI mismatch or port closed. Ask SI to run `nc -vz telemetry.acmehealth.internal 443` from their connector host and paste result.

bluearc-si: ran the check — `nc: connect to telemetry.acmehealth.internal port 443 (tcp) failed: Connection timed out`. Also saw intermittent 502 from our proxy when TLS session resumed.

mattp: network path issue then. Amelia — can we get traceroute and pkt capture? I'll triage with net team. @raj pls prepare recommended mTLS config snippet.

raj: will draft. quick suggestion: ensure `tls_server_name` matches cert CN and enable `session_resumption` in proxy. Sending snippet..

raj: ```yaml
proxy:
  upstream: telemetry.acmehealth.internal:443
  tls_server_name: telemetry.acmehealth.internal
  session_resumption: true
  ca_bundle: /etc/si/ca.pem
```

amelia: thanks. I'll schedule 30m sync with SI + net team at 10:30 PT. Anyone else?

sara: I'll prep customer comms and risk statement. :thumbsup:

mattp: I'll join. If net team confirms closed port, we advise SI to open 443 from connector range and we can roll forward.

bluearc-si: thanks — we'll run the nc/traceroute and post results before the sync.

amelia: perfect. I'll post calendar invite and include runbook steps. End of thread
